name: LE3D
definition: A method for HDR view synthesis from noisy RAW images that enables real-time rendering and fast training by replacing 3DGS spherical harmonics with a Color MLP, using Cone Scatter Initialization for SfM enrichment, and applying depth distortion and near-far regularizations.
summary: LE3D is a fast HDR view synthesis method for noisy RAW images that replaces 3D Gaussian Splatting's spherical harmonics with a Color MLP to enable real-time rendering and nighttime reconstruction.
